verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents escalation policies as "a custom set of rules for incident alerting" that can be configured by time, team availability and incident origin. Monitors automatically create incidents and alert the on-call person when checks fail, and unacknowledged incidents escalate automatically. However, the evidenced actions are limited to alerting and escalation rather than general event-driven automation. Missing for 10: arbitrary action types beyond notifications (e.g. webhooks or remediation triggers), a general rule/condition builder across logs and metrics events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
